name: speech-bubble
title: Speech Bubble
description: Manga speech bubble drawn in SVG at its real size and inscribed in its box, with real text inside. Variants: speech, thought (cloud), shout (spikes), whisper (dashed), narration (caption box), electronic (zigzag), wobbly (trembling). The tail points to top, bottom, start or end, aligned start/center/end, or none, and its room is reserved as margin; or pointAt={{ x, y }} (percent of the panel, in a Place) aims the tail at a point and lengthens it. Every length follows the font size, so on a Page the bubble scales with the page; there round bubbles square up a little to hold a block of text. align sets the text alignment, maxWidth the width limit (a percentage of the panel in a Place). BubbleGroup chains bubbles through a neck that hides both outlines.

meta.tagline: Seven bubble shapes drawn at their real size.
meta.usage:
import { SpeechBubble, BubbleGroup } from "@/components/manga/speech-bubble"

<SpeechBubble variant="shout" tail="bottom" tailAlign="end">Get down!</SpeechBubble>

// on a Page: placed in a panel, the tail aims at the speaker
<Place x="70%" y="10%" anchor="top">
  <SpeechBubble pointAt={{ x: "30%", y: "80%" }} align="start">Over here!</SpeechBubble>
</Place>

props.name: pointAt
props.type: { x: number | string; y: number | string }
props.description: A point to aim at, in percent of the panel (the Place frame): the tail turns and grows to reach it.

props.name: align
props.description: Text alignment (narration starts at the start).

props.name: maxWidth
props.description: Maximum width; in a Place a percentage is a share of the panel.
